Purpose of the project
Labeling target
Labeling process

Interior Segmentation Project is a project that labels interior space with the Polygon tool and classifies it into 42 classes.
The process involves viewing photos and tagging objects to create the necessary training dataset.
Make sure you don’t tag a category as undefined even if it already exists.

Door – Wooden doors, Turkish doors, etc.
Glass wall – Building exterior walls, meeting room wall, etc. / excludes glass in partitions
Glass door – Includes all glass doors and frames connected to the elevator spaces.
Signage – signs / ceiling bar type, vertical type or anything advertising something.
Make sure you don’t tag a category as undefined even if it already exists.

Furniture: desk – work desk.
Furniture: table – sofa table, conference table, etc.
Furniture: partition – Including glass
Make sure you don’t tag a category as undefined even if it already exists.

Appliance: floor vent – floor air conditioning system (air hole).
Appliance: floor outlet – floor power hole (including closed).
Appliance: vending machine – any vending machine type.
Please use the shortcut below to view colored images

Create a polygon for each object and tag it with the appropriate class.
Be careful not to leave any spaces between polygons
